messages:
Sara (ml): bringing up raven-lite int8 on small canary (500 reqs). seeing funcall structured-output parse failures jump to ~1.7% vs ~0.02% on baseline fp16. sample shows truncated suffix and a stray comma.

Ben (infra): is this right after quant or any infra change? which image?

Sara (ml): candidate raven-lite-int8:v2026-03-17-qa1 (quant rev 0x9f3). no infra changes. payload ends like: {"action":"open_file","path":"/tmp/x","args":{"line":42,}, — trailing comma and missing closing newline. parser -> JSONDecodeError: Extra data.

Kai: trailing comma could be tokenizer emitting extra "," after int8 rounding. repro with streaming vs full?

Sara (ml): repro on both. baseline with same prompts = clean. tried explicit stops.

Maria (qa): parse-bot, diff 10k canary responses for suffix anomalies?

parse-bot: running sample 10k candidate vs baseline, will report in ~20m.

Ben (infra): we can enable JSON-repair rescue on canary only: soft-heal trims trailing commas, try json5 then strict. capture repaired/unrepaired counts.

Sara (ml): propose: enable rescue for candidate A only + tag metrics + capture topk deltas around end-of-response.

Kai: also capture tokenizer->byte mapping for final tokens, suspect off-by-one where EOS shifts.

parse-bot: results: candidate failure 1.72% (172/10000), repairable 61% (105/172). baseline 0.03% (3/10000). median failure token-length = 18.

Sara (ml): please attach 20 failure examples with raw token ids + decoded bytes for triage.

parse-bot: uploaded 20 samples to s3: https://s3.redwood/tests/raven-lite/1737777001-samples.log.

Ben (infra): options: (1) keep candidate + repair on canary w/ telemetry, (2) fallback routing to baseline for toolcall endpoints, (3) rollback.

Kai: i'll rerun quant with group-size 64 vs 128 and symmetric calibration on failure set. might fix rounding artifacts.

Sara (ml): will run comparison and run Kai's token-diff script PR (https://git.redwood/eng/llm-tools/pull/421) on samples. Maria to triage repaired vs must-fail.

Maria (qa): triage done EOD PST: of 20 samples, 12 acceptable after repair (intent preserved), 8 corrupted (repair ambiguous). details in s3 manifest.

Sara (ml): leaning to block rollout until quant tweak. Kai — if re-run reduces corrupted to <=2/20 we can ramp with repair enabled.

Kai: starting reruns now, will post numbers and a canary artifact PR if good.

Ben (infra): configured mirror routing: candidate mirrored to baseline; baseline parse used on candidate parse-fail. TTL 6h, metrics tag mirror-parse-fallback=true. alert if mirror fallback > 0.5%.

Sara (ml): checklist: (a) rerun quant and report delta (b) parser-repair + telemetry on canary (c) human triage (d) decide rollout after 24h. thanks all :thumbsup:

Maria (qa): monitoring updated and samples uploaded.

Sara (ml): will update thread with results.
